pb-bookkeeping-cfo.heading: Collections
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.boundary: Your client reviews and sends every reminder. Chausar never contacts debtors.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.emptyLine: Upload your client debtor ledger on their service order, then record promises here. Use the same file name for later payment updates.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.complete: Choose an invoice and fill the promise details.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.stage.call: Call and email by a person
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.stage.lawyer: Lawyer review and pause new orders
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.noteBoundary: This note goes to your service client for review. They send any reminder themselves.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.stageBoundary: House defaults. Legal letters and write-offs always need a qualified person and your client to decide.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.INVALID_VENTURE: Check the promise fields and try again.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter a positive rupee amount with at most paise precision.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.INVOICE_NOT_FOU: Choose an invoice for this client in this business currency.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.CLIENT_NOT_FOUN: This client is no longer available. Refresh the list.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.PROMISE_NOT_FOU: This promise is no longer available. Refresh the list.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.COLLECTION_LADD: Keep the stage days in increasing order, starting on the first late day.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.APPROVAL_STALE: The item changed. Read it again before approving.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.APP_APPROVAL_RE: Approve this change inside the app.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.REQUEST_FAILED: The desk could not be read. Try again.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.CLIENT_LEDGER_R: Upload the client debtor ledger on their service order first.
pb-bookkeeping-cfo.error.CLIENT_LEDGER_I: Check the debtor ledger rows and column names, then upload it again.
